Checkout failures return 400/402/409/503, create no order row and send no email (ADR 0018).
Capture outcome may overtake DispatchConfirmed: PaymentCaptured/PaymentFailed are accepted from authorized or dispatched.
Customer cancellation does not release inventory — known gap.
